name: BMED 2300 benchmark corpus and evaluation harness

why: This is a single university's institution-specific intercalated research-degree design for medical students, not a reusable instructional element or a generally adoptable product.
BMESA is a named, purpose-built assessment instrument for measuring medical experimental skills and related competencies, not a general instructional element.
name: Basic Medical Experimental Skills Assessment (BMESA)
product_description: A college-developed 100-point-per-objective assessment used by medical undergraduate programs to evaluate mastery of basic medical experimental principles, procedures, problem analysis, skills, research design, and scientific writing.
